text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to resist the lure of the Japanese Derby, Manhattan Cafe enters the race. Ultimately, however, she fails to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race takes a toll on her body. Agnes Tachyon and I end up nursing her back to health, sparing no effort as we take care of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Managing to prevent Manhattan Cafe from suffering any serious issues, we hold out hope for the autumn season.
